entries.what: Linh wakes at 6:45 and rides the Kenji-ride/shuttle route to Tamsen Valley for Anatomy with Dr. Okoye at 9, then skips lunch again until her shift.
entries.outcome: Takes pages of color-coded notes on the muscles unit.

entries.what: Works the Monday 12-6 shift at Heron & Grind, pulling shots for the afternoon crowd and reviewing flashcards on breaks. Jun critiques her pour.
entries.outcome: Shift ends on time; Beatrice mentions the new evening hours start Wednesday.

entries.what: Eats the plate Hạnh left, then plans the week in her washi-tape planner and sets up Tuesday's study group.
entries.outcome: Planner filled in through Sunday.

entries.what: Gets a ride from Kenji to campus for General Chemistry at 11, then studies at the library until the group.
entries.outcome: Finishes a chem problem set early.

entries.what: At 4 p.m. she goes to Pedro's Tuesday anatomy study group at the library for the first time instead of studying alone; Pedro quizzes with his bag of 3D-printed bones.
entries.outcome: Learns the bone markings faster than alone and agrees to come back weekly.

entries.what: Gets home, packs tomorrow's rice bowl, and lays out clothes for her first closing shift.
entries.outcome: In bed around 12:30.

entries.what: Anatomy at 9 with Okoye, then a quick packed lunch on the library steps before heading to the cafe.
entries.outcome: Actually eats lunch.

entries.what: The cafe's new 6:30 a.m. to 9 p.m. hours begin and Linh works her first 3-9 closing shift at the new $19.25 rate. Beatrice shows her the milk-waste clipboard and has her lock the vault-room outlets at close.
entries.outcome: Closes without a mistake and clocks out near 9:30.

entries.what: Gets home late; Hạnh has left a plate out and Linh eats it cold while noting the raise in her budget.
entries.outcome: Updates her bike-fund tally.

entries.what: Thao's boyfriend Tomás finishes moving into unit 207; Thao mentions it by text before her night shift.
entries.outcome: Linh sends a thumbs-up and teases Thao.

entries.what: Rides with Kenji to campus for General Chemistry at 11 and reviews the yellow list afterward.
entries.outcome: Chem lecture makes sense; notes updated.

entries.what: Stops at Heron & Grind for a cortado and Wes calls her 'Doc' when he spots her flashcards.
entries.outcome: She laughs and uses the nickname back.

entries.what: Studies at home with the lo-fi playlist and her dad's old radio on the desk.
entries.outcome: Finishes the statistics module online.

entries.what: Anatomy at 9, then the library to quiz herself on the muscles of the arm.
entries.outcome: Gets through half the 600-card deck.

entries.what: Meets Kenji for a late lunch near campus and they swap transfer-application gossip.
entries.outcome: Kenji says he will submit his Bayshore app by Nov 30.

entries.what: Evening at home with Hạnh; Hạnh asks about pharmacy classes and Linh gives short answers.
entries.outcome: Conversation stays on the surface.

entries.what: Opens Heron & Grind at 6:30 for the Saturday shift in the new longer-hours schedule; Jun sells lumpia from the counter.
entries.outcome: Busy rush; Sam still owes her shifts.

entries.what: After the 1 p.m. end of shift she eats her packed rice bowl and reviews anatomy at a corner table.
entries.outcome: Leaves with a plan for Sunday.

entries.what: Hears from her cousin-type neighbors that Oscar Henríquez's pupusa stand opened in the Ruel Road gas station lot this evening; she plans to go with Thao later.
entries.outcome: Just a plan for later.

entries.what: Works the 6:30-1 Sunday cafe shift, pouring hearts and practicing the rosetta between orders.
entries.outcome: Rosetta still lopsided.

entries.what: Helps at the Lotus Nails front desk from 2 to 5 for Hạnh.
entries.outcome: Books appointments and gets praised by customers.

entries.what: Walks the Ulloa marsh boardwalk, then plans the week in her planner Sunday night.
entries.outcome: Week mapped out with color tags.
